title: Staff are told when a Supabase incident is the cause: red bar and clearer upload messages
text: When Supabase (our database and file storage) has an open incident that can affect us, a red bar appears at the top of the CRM, TD Talk and the Marketing workspace, quoting Supabase's own title and latest update. A failed workspace upload or a waiting chat message now says Supabase has an open storage incident instead of a generic error, so you know it is not your connection.
points: Antonio, Luca and Jodi get one notification when an incident opens and one when it is resolved.
Clients only see "Uploads are temporarily unavailable, please try again shortly." while a storage incident is open; they never see the cause.
If Supabase's status cannot be read, nothing is shown: it never claims all clear.
